description: This file generates a hierarchical role tree UI for the vtiger CRM Settings module, retrieving role data from the database, constructing a nested HTML list with controls for adding, editing, deleting, and moving roles, and rendering the output via Smarty templates.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering templates in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Recursively constructs the HTML for the role hierarchy tree, including expand/collapse controls and role management actions.
